description: Shopware Meteor is Shopware's design system and documentation site for its component library, design tokens, icon kit, and UI guidelines. It also publishes machine-readable documentation for AI tools via an MCP server and llms.txt files.
summary: meteor.shopware.com exposes a public MCP server at `https://meteor.shopware.com/mcp`; no HTTP/GraphQL API or CLI surface was documented on this domain.
